pages.quiz:
ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

4. C — 100 °C

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

6. B — Ice melting to water

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

9. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. D — Producers
